name: Nuun Sport Electrolyte Hydration Tablets (Citrus Fruit)
whyItWorks: Dissolvable effervescent tablet with 300mg sodium, 150mg potassium, and only 1g sugar. Convenient for purse or backpack travel hydration without excessive sweetness.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drop 1 tablet into 16 oz water. Let it completely dissolve and stop fizzing before drinking to minimize swallowed air.
